voice.name: Test Voice
voice.basis: the channel's established narrator (same id as glass-climbing, moth-silk-web-shooter and invisibility-shield voice_provenance.json); verified by creative_list_voices on 2026-10-26

settings: connector defaults (eleven_v4 exposes no speed setting through this connector; pace directed with inline delivery tags, which are not spoken)
prompt: [confident, quick] This cockroach can fire a needle. [conversational] And a person holding a remote decides when it shoots. [brisk, explaining] Scientists strapped a tiny launcher onto a living cockroach, then used electrical pulses to steer it. A second cockroach carries a camera, letting the operator watch as the first moves into position. Once it lines up, they fire the injector. They've demonstrated this on laboratory targets. [turning, intrigued] But the plan is to send them beneath collapsed buildings, carrying emergency medicine. [quieter, closer] So if you're trapped and something starts crawling toward you… [warm, knowing] you might actually want it to get closer.
why_kept: one coherent take; Whisper base.en transcribes it with no word errors and Zipformer differs only by spelling ('onto' -> 'on to'); no delivery tag is spoken; first line 1.88 s (target 1.7-2.0 s); sentence pauses 0.15-0.53 s; the pause before the last clause 0.40 s; first word at 0.00 s, last word ends 30.59 s. No reason to regenerate (delivery, pronunciation, missing words or timing).
format_note: the restricted connector returns MP3 (44.1 kHz, 128 kb/s, mono); it does not offer a higher output format, so this is the highest available. The editing WAV is a single decode of it.

final.edits: none: decoded once (ffmpeg) from the take; no cut, splice, time-stretch, pitch change or gain change

word_timing.master: PocketSphinx forced alignment of the locked words on the take (tools/align_sphinx.py), snapped to measured pause edges (RMS < -45 dBFS for >= 100 ms) (tools/make_narration.py)
word_timing.cross_reference: ElevenLabs Scribe (eleven_scribe_v1) alignment of the same take, kept per word in FGW_Cyborg_Cockroach_V1_words.json; it drifts up to 0.48 s on 'camera' and 'position' (contradicted by the measured pauses), so it is not the master
word_timing.speech_with_timestamps_endpoint: not exposed by the connected ElevenLabs connector; alignment was done locally as the brief allows
